# Events / academic calendar research (window 2026-07-01 ~ 2026-10-31)

Status: FINAL (time-boxed, not exhaustive). Researched 2026-11-12.
- "verified" = date read from a fetched page (official calendar, news article, ticket page).
- "not verified" = seen only in a search-result snippet, or not found at all.
- "pre-event" = the fetched page was an announcement; no post-event report was fetched.
- Nearest station / line assignments are my own geographic knowledge, not taken from the fetched pages.
- No ridership figures were looked up.

## D. Modelling notes (facts only)

- 2026-09-12 (Sat) stacks two Incheon Line 1 events: I♥FEsta 송도 (센트럴파크) and PLAVE night 1 at 문학경기장 (19:00); PLAVE night 2 is 09-13 (Sun).
- Year-over-year date shifts: 부평풍물대축제 09-26~28 (2025) -> 10-02~04 (2026); BICOF 09-26~28 -> 09-18~20; I♥FEsta 송도 09-06 -> 09-12; 시민의 날 대축제 moved venue 남동체육관 (2025-10-11) -> 인천대공원 (2026-10-10); 경인교대 대동제 09-24~25 -> 09-30~10-01.
- 추석: 2026-09-24~09-26 (Thu-Sat); 2025-10-05~10-07 plus 대체공휴일 10-08 (from the university calendars).
- 인천대 대동제 is a May event in 2026, so it does not fall in the window.
